checks.message: August is complete only up to the 23rd. From 24 August the number of orders falls to between 1 and 99 per day, against about 195 on a normal day, and no order of 30-31 August is delivered yet. The full-month comparison (-4.1%) compares 23 complete days with 31.

evidence.rule: trailing days with volume < 60% of the other period's median

checks.message: Same population on both sides: customers' delivered orders (Revenue@2.0 filter order_status = 'delivered').
Both periods are calendar months of 31 days, both values are totals.
Both values come from fact_payments (one row = one payment).

proposed_fix.justification: 23 is the last complete day of August. Using the same 23 days in July compares equal amounts of time.

alternatives.description: Compare revenue per day: 1-23 August against the whole of July.
alternatives.justification: July's orders are concentrated at the end of the month (1,949 of its 6,292 orders after the 23rd), so the first 23 days undervalue July. A daily average uses every complete day of both months.
